To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to activate SeedKit promo (missed enrollment window)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the SeedKit intro last month — Lumina absolutely loved the quickstart guidance. We ran into a scheduling change on our side and missed the formal enrollment deadline for the SeedKit promotional credits. Our product launch slipped by a few weeks and we only started integrating last week.

Would Redwood consider activating the SeedKit promo for Lumina despite the deadline? We fit the program profile (pre-seed, YC-alum cohort, early ML inference usage) and we have an upcoming pilot with a pilot partner that would materially accelerate usage. If you can activate the promo for 90 days we can commit to the pilot milestones and funnel Redwood feedback into our integration notes.

Quick context:
- Team: 6 engineers, 2 ML researchers
- Expected peak: ~120k tokens/day during pilot
- Pilot partner: BrightCart (retail POC)

I can share a usage snapshot and the pilot plan. Appreciate any flexibility here.

Best,
Sara Kim
Co-founder & CTO, Lumina Labs
Sara@lumina.ai

Attachment: lumina_usage_snapshot.csv (summary of last 7 days)

I looped in Marcus (AE) and Neha (Growth) to evaluate whether we can make an exception and what the activation would look like from a terms and usage perspective. A few quick clarifying items that will help move this along:

1) Can you confirm the pilot start date and the 90-day window you’re requesting?
2) Do you have a short pilot milestone plan (bullet list) we can attach to the activation?
3) Are there any regulatory constraints (data residency, redaction) we should note?

If it helps, attach the pilot plan and I’ll pull the usage snapshot into a short memo for approval. We’ll aim to get a decision within 24–36 hours.

Subject: Lumina Labs — SeedKit promo activation request (need approval)

Marcus / Neha — forwarding Sara’s ask. Summary below and a proposed activation path:

Summary:
- Company: Lumina Labs (pre-seed, YC alumni)
- Ask: retroactive activation of SeedKit promo for a 90-day window to support a BrightCart pilot
- Usage: they expect ~120k tokens/day during pilot; their attached snapshot shows recent low activity but spiky integration traffic

Proposed terms (low-risk, tight guardrails):
- 90-day promo window from activation date
- Promo allotment: $7,500 equivalent (roughly 1.1M tokens at current price) — enough to cover pilot peak with modest overage buffer
- Requirement: customer to sign promotional T&Cs and fill short pilot milestone doc (1 page) — attach to HubSpot record
- Auto-fallback: after promo depletion or window expiry, bill at standard rates unless they sign a committed Reserved plan

Attachments: lumina_usage_snapshot.csv (from Sara) and a draft promo_terms.pdf I prepared.

Questions for you: is $7.5k an acceptable promo size? Or would you prefer smaller initial allocation with a top-up option tied to milestones? Also flag any compliance objections — they mentioned no special residency needs.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachment: seedkit_promo_terms.pdf (draft promotional terms)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina Labs — SeedKit promo activation request (need approval)

Thanks for the summary. Quick notes from AE perspective:

- Lumina is a strategic fit for SeedKit (strong developer team + clear pilot partner).
- $7.5k seems reasonable as a one-time promo to de-risk the initial pilot. We can structure as a non-recurring credit tied to milestones.
- Require milestone doc + a short commitment to capture learnings and provide product feedback (we want to surface any inference correctness/regression issues).

Operational asks:
- Please include the pilot start/end dates and milestone checkpoints in the doc before activation.
- Send the draft promo_terms.pdf to Legal for a quick stamp — I’ll escalate if they push back.

Approve the activation at $7,500 credit, conditional on milestones and signed promotional T&Cs. I’ll sync with Revenue Ops for provisioning once Legal gives the OK.

– Marcus

marcus_lin@redwood.com

Hi Sara — good news: we can activate the SeedKit promotional credit for Lumina with a few conditions.

What we’re approving:
- A $7,500 non-recurring credit applied to your account, active for 90 days from activation.
- Activation will occur once we receive a signed copy of the one-page pilot milestone doc and your acceptance of the promo T&Cs (attached).

What we need from you to finalize by EOD Thu (10 Jun):
1) Pilot start date and end date (confirm exactly when the 90-day window should begin).
2) One-page milestone plan (bullets: integration checkpoint, partner demo, success criteria).
3) Signed promotional T&Cs — we can accept an e-signature (DocuSign link included below) or a signed PDF upload.

Next steps from our side: Marcus will escalate to Legal for a quick sign-off on the promo_terms.pdf; once Legal signs off we’ll provision the credit and share the activation date and promo id. I’ve attached a finalized promo_terms.pdf and a short promo_activation_record.pdf that Revenue Ops will use to provision the credit.
